verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP documentation explicitly lists "Bulk delete emails" and "Bulk archive emails" as tools, so an AI agent can act on many emails at once. Label modification and label management are also listed, but not described as bulk operations. The support rests on one-line feature bullets with no detail on scope, limits, or how items are selected. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond delete and archive (e.g., bulk labeling, mark-read, moving), documentation of how many items a call can handle and how selection works, any in-app bulk-select evidence, and hands-on or independent confirmation that the bulk tools work.
